name: den
description: ddoghq/den (private). Gates mirror den's own developer bar: validation = pre-push (fmt + clippy) + no-docker Tier-1, deploy = Tier-2 kind e2e (`bash ci/e2e.sh`) inside the sandbox, observation = instant e2e. merge_mode=manual: a human merges the PR on GitHub (ADR-0070).

config.test_commands: cd /work/repo && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --workspace --exclude den-slt --exclude den-pg-stores && cargo test -p den-slt --test mem --locked
config.lint_commands: cd /work/repo && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

repo.description: ddoghq/den (private). Cargo workspace (crates/den + crates/libs/* default members). rust-toolchain.toml pins nightly-2026-04-30 — preparation runs `rustup show` to install it before the checkout baseline. Validation = den's own pre-push bar (fmt + clippy -D warnings) plus no-docker Tier-1 tests (den-slt/pg testcontainers excluded, per den README). Deploy = Tier-2 `bash ci/e2e.sh`: builds the reviewed head, provisions an ephemeral kind cluster in the sandbox (dind), deploys Postgres + MinIO + den-cluster x3, runs the distributed e2e Job in-cluster, tears down (~15-20 min, 2700s budget). Observation = in-process instant e2e (`cargo test -p den --test e2e`).
